jobs.title: Senior Internal Auditor
jobs.description: WIBS PHP INC. is a BSP-licensed Electronic Money Issuer and Virtual Asset Service Provider. The Senior Internal Auditor will lead assigned reviews of financial, operational, and compliance controls across our payments, wallet, and virtual asset operations. Responsibilities • Scope assigned engagements, conduct walkthroughs, document risks and controls, and design and execute testing. • Evaluate the adequacy of records, approvals, segregation of duties, and supporting evidence. Maintain clear and reproducible workpapers. • Draft findings with evidence, root cause, risk impact, and practical recommendations. Discuss findings professionally while maintaining audit independence. • Track agreed actions, retest the affected control before recommending closure, and escalate material or overdue items. Keep conclusions traceable to the evidence. • Improve audit programs and documentation standards, and support external audit and examination readiness. Work arrangement: On-site at Ayala Avenue, Makati City, Monday to Friday, day shift. Benefits include HMO upon regularization, paid holidays, paid vacation leave, and transportation allowance.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description: Hire Manila is recruiting an Operations Manager on behalf of a growing Filipino functional beverage company that is expanding its retail and e-commerce distribution. You’ll manage retail purchase orders from receipt through delivery, coordinate production with third-party manufacturers, and keep inventory and online orders moving. This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role with room to grow into broader leadership as the business expands. You’ll have the autonomy to run daily operations and will help pick, pack, and dispatch online orders when needed. What you’ll do Manage retail purchase orders and deliveries. Verify quantities, deadlines, and documentation, coordinate deliveries to retailer distribution centers, and resolve discrepancies between purchase orders, invoices, and received stock. Coordinate production with manufacturers and suppliers. Confirm production schedules, quantities, and packaging requirements, follow up on delays, and arrange pickup of finished goods. Keep inventory accurate across retail and e-commerce. Track stock movement, conduct physical counts, reconcile discrepancies, and manage stock allocation and replenishment. Run daily e-commerce fulfillment. Manage orders across Shopify, TikTok Shop, and other platforms, coordinate courier pickups, handle returns and failed deliveries, and help prepare orders for dispatch. Improve day-to-day operations. Maintain purchase order and inventory trackers, document standard procedures, and prepare regular reports for management.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.description: Develop and execute growth strategies aligned with the client’s revenue, customer acquisition, retention and brand objectives. Manage e-commerce performance, including Shopify, product merchandising, promotions, conversion optimization and the overall customer journey. Plan, manage and optimize paid media campaigns, particularly Meta Ads, covering targeting, creative testing, campaign structure and budget allocation. Monitor key metrics, including revenue, ROAS, CAC, conversion rate, average order value and repeat purchase rate, and deliver weekly and monthly reports with actionable recommendations. Lead structured testing across creative, audiences, offers, landing pages and promotions to improve acquisition, conversion, retention and customer lifetime value. Collaborate with the Founder on product launches, promotional calendars, brand campaigns and retail partnerships, ensuring digital and retail activities support overall growth objectives. Lead and coordinate the marketing team, setting clear priorities, timelines and deliverables; translate performance insights into creative briefs and evaluate creator partnerships for paid media opportunities. Analyze customer, competitor and market trends, identify emerging growth opportunities, and improve marketing tools, workflows and processes as the business scales.

We are hiring a Treasury and Reconciliation Officer to support the daily financial operations of DOPAY and our payments business. Responsibilities • Perform daily reconciliation across bank statements, DOPAY transaction records, and the accounting ledger. jobs.title: Senior Sales and Marketing Officer
jobs.description: WIBS PHP INC. is a BSP-licensed Electronic Money Issuer and Virtual Asset Service Provider based in Makati. As Senior Sales and Marketing Officer, you will help build our remittance business for overseas Filipino workers (OFWs), with an initial focus on the Japan–Philippines corridor. Responsibilities • Build a pipeline of qualified customers and prospective partners. Develop relationships with OFW communities, employers, staffing organizations, and potential referral and distribution partners. • Own outreach, customer education, and follow-up. Help customers through account registration and document submission, identify onboarding friction, and coordinate verification handoffs with the authorized teams. • Plan and run approved campaigns and partner initiatives. Track leads, completed registrations, account activations, and, where available, first and repeat remittances. Use those results to improve outreach and onboarding. • Coordinate customer inquiries and transaction exceptions with Operations and Compliance. Follow the established approval processes for account verification, transactions, partnerships, and marketing materials. Work location: On-site at Ayala Avenue, Makati City.

jobs.title: Senior Risk Management Officer
jobs.description: WIBS PHP INC. is a BSP-licensed Electronic Money Issuer and Virtual Asset Service Provider based in Makati. As Senior Risk Management Officer, you will own key risk workstreams and translate findings into decisions for management and the Board. Responsibilities • Maintain the enterprise risk framework, risk register, risk appetite metrics, and KRIs. Assess operational, financial, liquidity, technology, cybersecurity, vendor, and strategic risks. • Produce evidence-based risk reports and stress-test analyses, recommend mitigations, and track owners, deadlines, and closure evidence. Escalate breaches and material exposures to management and relevant governance bodies. • Lead business impact analyses, update business continuity and disaster recovery plans, coordinate exercises, and verify remediation. • Translate relevant regulatory changes into updates to risk policies, controls, and reporting. Maintain evidence for examinations and audits. • Work with Compliance, AML, Operations, Treasury, Technology, and Internal Audit while exercising independent risk judgment and escalating unresolved exposures through the appropriate governance channels. Work location: On-site at Ayala Avenue, Makati City.
